raw_prompt: Implement real-time flight data recorder buffer synchronization that flushes ARINC 429 bus frames to solid-state crash-survivable memory on power loss.

flight data recorder.rationale: Avionics system aggregate responsible for persisting flight telemetry.

buffer synchronization.rationale: Dynamic state synchronization between volatile telemetry buffer and storage.

flushes.rationale: Atomic I/O transfer operation writing memory buffer to non-volatile storage.

ARINC 429 bus frames.rationale: Standard avionics 32-bit data word / frame protocol payload.

on power loss.rationale: Environmental hardware interrupt / trigger condition defining the critical execution window.

real-time.rationale: Deterministic bounded latency timing constraint for avionics data processing.
